description_expanded: Overview5.0(22 reviews)The Hammocks in Old Seagrove - Gated Neighborhood with Community Pool - Public Beach - 3 minute Bike Ride - 4 Bikes IncludedThe SpaceQUICK HIGHLIGHTS: 4 Adult Bikes Included – Explore 30A with ease! Impeccably Designed – Thoughtfully curated for ultimate comfort. Wi-Fi & Flat Screen TVs – Stay connected & entertained. Community Pool – Just steps away! (No pool heat available). Driveway - 2 Cars – Convenient parking for your stay.Welcome to The HammocksWelcome to paradise! This gorgeous 3 bedroom and 2.5 bath home is just what you have been looking for. This home will fill all of your vacation needs. The best part is it's a short stroll to the beach and the community pool is just a few steps away!As you walk into the front door, you will see the gorgeous living room with ample seating for everyone. Guests are welcomed by an open living area that captures 30A’s laid back attitude. The first floor is home to the kitchen and living room, with dining space for 6. The granite counter tops and stainless-steel appliances make for a stunning kitchen.The front porch is the perfect spot for winding up in the morning with coffee, or chilling out in the evening for an after-beach refreshment.All of the bedrooms are located on the second floor. The master has a King bed and en suite bathroom, with a stand-alone shower/tub combination! There are two other bedrooms; one has a King sized bed and one has a Queen sized bed and share a jack and Jill bathroom with a stand alone shower.In the hallway, is a twin sized day bed and a wonderful desk surrounded with gorgeous windows for those who enjoy writing, drawing, or even those who are enjoying a working vacation.Spend your vacation here and create a vacation you will never forget!House Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival****NO CABLE TV. NETFLIX ONLY**SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (7):Bedroom 1: 1 KingBedroom 2: 1 QueenBedroom 3: 1 KingLoft daybed: 1 twin/ single (not in a bedroom)Bathrooms:Bathroom 1: toilet, showerBathroom 2: toilet, combination tub/showerBathroom 3: toiletAREA ATTRACTIONS:Discover the charm of Seagrove, a beach neighborhood that locals and guests love. Lush oak trees, magnolias, and pines have spread deep roots in Seagrove — and so have long-time visitors who keep coming back.Laid-back but luxurious, Seagrove is a place that embraces variety. From upscale boutiques to casual cafes, this beach neighborhood offers a little bit of everything — including two rare coastal dune lakes, a state park, and sugar-white sand. Pack a picnic, fishing pole, and binoculars — and witness how stunning Seagrove is in its all-natural state. Its sugar-white sand has been a peaceful retreat in South Walton for decades; here, old and new Gulf Coast style merge to create a charming beach neighborhood with everything one may need for a truly relaxing getaway.Show less
